name: netbox__netbox_list_object_types
description:
List the NetBox object types these tools accept, with their API endpoints.

Types are named 'app.model' (e.g. 'dcim.device'). Plugin types appear when
the server runs with plugin discovery enabled.

app.description: Only types of this app, e.g. 'dcim', 'ipam', 'netbox_dns'.

rediscover.description: Re-read plugin types from NetBox (plugin discovery must be enabled on the server).

name: netbox__netbox_get_objects
description:
List NetBox objects of one type, with filtering and pagination.

Returns 'results' plus 'total' (all matches) and 'has_more'/'next_offset'.
Results are paginated - check 'has_more' before concluding. To count
objects cheaply use fields=['id'] and limit=1 and read 'total'.

object_type.description: NetBox object type as 'app.model' (e.g. 'dcim.device', 'ipam.ipaddress', 'virtualization.virtualmachine') or as an API path ('dcim/devices'). netbox_list_object_types lists every type.

filters.description: NetBox filters, e.g. {'site_id': 1, 'status': 'active', 'name__ic': 'core'}. Pass a list for OR: {'id': [1, 2]}. null matches empty: {'tenant_id': None}. Lookup suffixes: n, ic, nic, isw, nisw, iew, niew, ie, nie, empty, regex, iregex, lt, lte, gt, gte. NOT supported: '__in' and multi-hop lookups like 'device__site_id' - query the related object first, then filter by its ID.

fields.description: Only return these fields, e.g. ['id', 'name', 'status']. ALWAYS pass this for listings - full objects cost 10x more tokens.

omit.description: Drop these fields from the response, e.g. ['config_context', 'custom_fields']. NetBox 4.5.2+. Ignored when 'fields' is set.

brief.description: Return the minimal representation (id, url, display, name).

ordering.description: Sort field(s); prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. 'name' or ['site', '-name'].

name: netbox__netbox_get_object
description: Get one NetBox object by type and ID.

object_type.description: NetBox object type as 'app.model' (e.g. 'dcim.device', 'ipam.ipaddress', 'virtualization.virtualmachine') or as an API path ('dcim/devices'). netbox_list_object_types lists every type.

fields.description: Only return these fields, e.g. ['id', 'name', 'status']. ALWAYS pass this for listings - full objects cost 10x more tokens.

omit.description: Drop these fields from the response, e.g. ['config_context', 'custom_fields']. NetBox 4.5.2+. Ignored when 'fields' is set.

brief.description: Return the minimal representation (id, url, display, name).

name: netbox__netbox_search_objects
description:
Search several NetBox object types at once with NetBox's 'q' filter.

Returns results keyed by object type. A '_meta' key appears when some
types failed ('errors' - treat as unknown, NOT as "no match") or had more
matches than 'limit' ('truncated' - the full count per type).

query.description: Free text: a name, IP, serial, asset tag, description...

object_types.description: Types to search. Default: dcim.device, dcim.site, ipam.ipaddress, ipam.prefix, dcim.interface, dcim.rack, ipam.vlan, circuits.circuit, virtualization.virtualmachine

fields.description: Only return these fields, e.g. ['id', 'name', 'status']. ALWAYS pass this for listings - full objects cost 10x more tokens.

name: netbox__netbox_describe_object_type
description:
Describe the writable fields of an object type: type, required, choices.

Call this before creating or updating an object to build a valid payload.
Foreign keys take the related object's numeric ID.

object_type.description: NetBox object type as 'app.model' (e.g. 'dcim.device', 'ipam.ipaddress', 'virtualization.virtualmachine') or as an API path ('dcim/devices'). netbox_list_object_types lists every type.

name: netbox__netbox_get_changelogs
description:
List change log entries (who changed what and when), newest first.

Each entry has action (create/update/delete), user_name, time,
changed_object_type/id and object_repr. Entries of one request share a
request_id. Set include_data to see what exactly changed.

include_data.description: Include prechange_data/postchange_data - the full object before and after the change (several KB per entry). Use it with a narrow filter, e.g. one changed_object_id.

name: netbox__netbox_get_available
description:
List free IPs, child prefixes, VLAN IDs or ASNs in a pool.

Examples: free IPs in prefix 12 -> ('ipam.prefix', 12, 'ips'); free /24s
in a prefix -> ('ipam.prefix', 12, 'prefixes'); free VLAN IDs in group 3
-> ('ipam.vlangroup', 3, 'vlans').

parent_type.description: Type of the parent object that holds the pool.

kind.description: What to look for: 'ips' (prefix or IP range), 'prefixes' (prefix), 'vlans' (VLAN group), 'asns' (ASN range).

name: netbox__netbox_trace_cable
description:
Trace cable paths from a port through patch panels and circuits.

For an interface, console, power port/outlet or power feed: the path
from it to the far end, one hop (near end, cable, far end) per segment.
For a pass-through port (front/rear port, circuit termination): every
cable path running through it, each as its list of nodes.

name: netbox__netbox_create_object
description:
Create one NetBox object. Returns the created object.

Look up related objects first (netbox_get_objects) and pass their IDs.

object_type.description: NetBox object type as 'app.model' (e.g. 'dcim.device', 'ipam.ipaddress', 'virtualization.virtualmachine') or as an API path ('dcim/devices'). netbox_list_object_types lists every type.

data.description: Field values. Foreign keys take numeric IDs, e.g. {'name': 'sw01', 'device_type': 4, 'role': 2, 'site': 1, 'status': 'active'}. Tags: [{'name': 'core'}] or [3]. Use netbox_describe_object_type for the fields and choices.

name: netbox__netbox_update_object
description:
Update fields of one NetBox object (partial update). Returns the
updated object.

object_type.description: NetBox object type as 'app.model' (e.g. 'dcim.device', 'ipam.ipaddress', 'virtualization.virtualmachine') or as an API path ('dcim/devices'). netbox_list_object_types lists every type.

data.description: Only the fields to change (PATCH), e.g. {'status': 'offline', 'description': 'RMA'}.

name: netbox__netbox_allocate_available
description:
Allocate the next free IP, prefix, VLAN or ASN from a pool and create
it. NetBox picks the value atomically, so concurrent callers never get
the same one.

parent_type.description: Type of the parent object that holds the pool.

kind.description: What to look for: 'ips' (prefix or IP range), 'prefixes' (prefix), 'vlans' (VLAN group), 'asns' (ASN range).

data.description: Attributes of the new object(s). Prefixes need {'prefix_length': 24}; VLANs need {'name': 'users'}. A list allocates several at once, e.g. [{'description': 'a'}, {'description': 'b'}] for two IPs.

name: netbox__netbox_delete_object
description:
Permanently delete one NetBox object. Dependent objects may be deleted
with it (e.g. a device's interfaces). Confirm with the user first.

object_type.description: NetBox object type as 'app.model' (e.g. 'dcim.device', 'ipam.ipaddress', 'virtualization.virtualmachine') or as an API path ('dcim/devices'). netbox_list_object_types lists every type.

name: netbox__netbox_connect_cable
description:
Connect ports with a new cable.

Ports can be given by device and name - no ID lookups needed. Fails
before writing if a port is not found, is ambiguous or is already
cabled. Use netbox_trace_cable afterwards to check the path.

a_terminations.description: Ports on this end, usually one, e.g. [{'object_type': 'dcim.interface', 'device': 'sw01', 'name': 'eth1'}] or [{'object_type': 'dcim.frontport', 'object_id': 42}].

items.description: One end of a cable: a port given by ID, or by its device and name.

device.description: Device name or numeric ID (with 'name'; device ports only).

name.description: Port name on that device, e.g. 'eth0'.

b_terminations.description: Ports on this end, usually one, e.g. [{'object_type': 'dcim.interface', 'device': 'sw01', 'name': 'eth1'}] or [{'object_type': 'dcim.frontport', 'object_id': 42}].

items.description: One end of a cable: a port given by ID, or by its device and name.

device.description: Device name or numeric ID (with 'name'; device ports only).

name.description: Port name on that device, e.g. 'eth0'.
